'''Udrin Cara''' was a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military design center in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Jeres Moridon]] was stationed there as a researcher, where he was exposed to [[Maladeria II]], a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] gas that was being researched at the facility for possible military applications.
